freshness.rule: stale evidence forbids trend or compounding claims

rules: all five product repositories must be represented in the run evidence
ELIGIBLE projects require SENSE, REMEMBER, and DECIDE before execution
record prior-learning retrieval before editing known areas
ELIGIBLE projects require explicit pre-change risk evidence before ACT
material advancement requires ACT plus VERIFY evidence
LEARN and ADAPT must explicitly close or be NOT_APPLICABLE
Product Reality is lane-scoped and never inferred
orchestrator-only work does not count as product advancement
material advancement requires explicit execution_evidence_ref and verification_evidence_ref bound to real product work

pre_change_risk.rule: risk profile is created after scope is known and before ACT; no-history is explicit evidence, not a low-risk claim

execution_evidence.rule: ACT/VERIFY stage labels are not sufficient; advancement must cite the concrete product commit/branch/PR and its exact-head verification evidence
forbidden: orchestrator-only commit counted as product execution
verification claim without concrete evidence ref
